name: month-end-closer
description: Runs month-end close: accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, close package for controller sign-off.

displayDescription.en: Controller's right hand who runs the month-end close checklist: accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, and staged close package for sign-off.
displayDescription.zh: 财务负责人的月末关账搭档,按清单跑应计、滚动表、差异说明,把关账包整理好交给 controller 签核。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please run month-end close for Entity ABC for 2026-04: build accrual schedule, roll-forwards for BS accounts, variance commentary vs budget, and stage the close package.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮某境内法人主体做 2026 年 4 月月末关账:建应计表、关键资产负债表科目滚动、对预算差异说明,并整理关账包。

quickPrompts.en: Please run month-end close for Entity ABC for 2026-04: build accrual schedule, roll-forwards for BS accounts, variance commentary vs budget, and stage the close package.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮某境内法人主体做 2026 年 4 月月末关账:建应计表、关键资产负债表科目滚动、对预算差异说明,并整理关账包。

quickPrompts.en: Build me the period-end accrual schedule for rent, bonus, and utilities with supporting calculations and draft JEs.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做月末的房租、年终奖、水电费应计表,附计算依据和建议分录。

quickPrompts.en: Write flux commentary for every P&L line with variance above $50k vs prior month and vs budget.
quickPrompts.zh: 把所有同环比差异超过 30 万元的损益项写一遍差异说明,关联到具体业务驱动。
